rewrite_rules._comment: Codified 'Needs a rewrite' rules for short descriptions that exist but won't hold up. Each enabled rule that fires adds one reason.

no_outcome_cue.message: No outcome or success criterion stated.

queries.jql: project in (TRM, SUP, TT, GE, DVR, HSER, IL) AND assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY project ASC, updated DESC
queries.description: Everything open assigned to the profile owner. After it returns, run focus-comments for the second query.
